body: U+0023# 2026-09-30: Impeller switch, Flutter 3.47.5 upgrade and Meadow fixes, specced and dispatchedU+000AU+000ASpec docs/specs/impeller-upgrade-meadow-fixes.md (interphase bug pathway, approved at sha256 44fa527d...), 12 Steps in .items.json, decisions in .decisions.md, repro .repro.dart.U+000AU+000ARoot causes confirmed by probes:U+000AU+002D **White night mountains / colour shift on Impeller.** A drawImage whose Paint carries a colorFilter AND a non-default blendMode ignores the blend on Impeller (3.47.5). Affects MeadowLandMask.apply (dstIn), _composeMountains, _composeWater and _FallParts.recoloured (plus). Fix: blend on a saveLayer, filter on the image. The mask also needs clipRect(rect), because on Skia a dstIn layer restore clears outside the layer.U+000AU+002D **Phone opening 1.45-1.9 s, frames 140-640 ms.** The build runs one step per frame (~150 steps), and the plant atlas is rasterised in one ~185 ms bake. The next frame waits on the GPU for it.U+000AU+002D **Noon cost.** Water glints drawn with a per-mark ColorFilter.mode plus ImageShader, one offscreen pass each on Impeller. Mac probe: 9.7 -> 5.5 ms with glints off; one masked layer (maskToWater) removes the cost. Not yet confirmed on the phone, which stayed locked; noon-fix.apk is built in the session scratchpad.U+000AU+002D **Note10+ runs Impeller OpenGL ES, not Vulkan.** Flutter's IsKnownBadDriver rejects Adreno U+003C= 650 (PR #178833). This cannot be overridden in release.U+000AU+000AOwner decisions this round:U+000AU+002D Android 10 minimum.U+000AU+002D Spruce reworded.U+000AU+002D Unknown mood tolerated.U+000AU+002D camera_macos SPM.U+000AU+002D Shared window clearance.U+000AU+002D 3 stacked PRs.U+000AU+002D Impeller tests local plus gate only.U+000AU+002D Loading text moved to PR 2.U+000AU+002D The six Meadow page goldens are owned by PR 2 (PR 1 leaves them failing locally in UTC-6).U+000AU+000ADispatch:U+000AU+002D Global Flutter upgraded to 3.47.5 via `flutter upgrade --force`.U+000AU+002D Feature branch impeller-base (local only) at f552f46.U+000AU+002D Run setup at ~/.mitosis/field-notes/impeller/; run dir ~/.mitosis/runs/field-notes/2026-09-30-impeller.U+000AU+002D accept.zsh runs test/impeller/* with --enable-impeller.
